The projective finite birational map P(S1)×P(S2)→X is normalization: exactly three smooth preimage branches of dimension 7. Their affine-cone tangent images have rank 8, pairwise sums rank 9 and combined sum rank 10; common projective intersection tangent is the 6-dimensional smooth nonconcurrent triangle stratum Z. Two branch intersections have scheme support Z and tangent embedding dimension 6, hence are regular/reduced and exactly Z. Independent normal tangent directions and Nakayama/formal straightening give exact completed branch ideals (v,w),(u,w),(u,v), so the reduced local ideal is (uv,uw,vw). Thus Hilbert series (1+2T)/(1−T)^7, dimension7, embedding9, mult3, CM type2; normalization three formal branch power-series rings with equal restrictions along the 6-dimensional Z, and conductor (u,v,w). Independently computed rank 8 per tangent and 9 per pair and 10 in total with Sympy for xyz. This is not asserted for concurrent triples or repeated lines.
